name: Quick Hands (Ex)
body:
Benefit: The saboteur becomes adept at hiding weapons. She gains Quick Draw as a bonus feat. She adds half her saboteur level on Sleight of Hand checks to hide a weapon, and drawing a hidden weapon becomes a swift action for her. This bonus to Sleight of Hand checks does not stack with the bonus on Sleight of Hand checks provided by charlatan’s mark.
